'''Michel Broué''' (born 28 October 1946) is a French [[mathematician]]. He holds a chair at [[Paris Diderot University]]. Broué has made contributions to [[algebraic geometry]] and [[representation theory]].

In 2012 he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2012-11-10.</ref>

He is the son of French historian [[Pierre Broué]] and of Simone Charras,<ref>{{cite journal|title=Pierre Broué (1926–2005)|first=Vincent|last=Présumey|date=January 2006|url=https://www.marxists.org/history/etol/revhist/backiss/vol9/no4/presumey.html|journal=Revolutionary History|volume=9|issue=4}}</ref> and the father of French director and screenwriter Isabelle Broué and of French journalist and radio producer [[Caroline Broué]].<ref name=renault>{{cite magazine|language=fr|url=https://www.liberation.fr/cinema/2018/04/05/isabelle-broue-doculmentee_1641301/|magazine=Libération|title=Portrait : Isabelle Broué, docu(l)mentée|date=5 April 2018|first=Gilles|last=Renault|access-date=2024-05-18}}</ref> He married actress [[Anouk Grinberg]], his partner since 2003, in 2016.<ref name=renault/><ref>{{Cite journal|language=fr|author1=Laurent Carpentier|title=Un apéro avec Anouk Grinberg|periodical=Le Monde.fr|date=2021-09-18|url=https://www.lemonde.fr/m-le-mag/article/2021/09/18/un-apero-avec-anouk-grinberg-est-ce-que-je-suis-quelqu-un-de-sincere-moi-qui-triche-tout-le-temps_6095103_4500055.html|access-date=2023-01-17}}</ref>

==Biography==
After completing his senior year at the high school in [[Montereau-Fault-Yonne]] (Seine-et-Marne) and preparatory classes at the Lycée Saint-Louis, he enrolled in 1966 at the École normale supérieure de Saint-Cloud,<ref>{{cite web |language=fr |title=Gérard Depardieu : "On l’a encouragé à se comporter comme un porc", le compagnon de l’actrice Anouk Grinberg soutient #MeToo |url=https://www.midilibre.fr/2024/05/02/gerard-depardieu-on-la-encourage-a-se-comporter-comme-un-porc-le-compagnon-de-lactrice-anouck-grinberg-soutient-metoo-11925723.php |website=midilibre.fr }}</ref> from which he graduated in 1970 with an agrégation in mathematics and a postgraduate doctorate (thesis supervised by Claude Chevalley and, in part, by [[Jean-Pierre Serre]]).
